long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Belgium to a Pakistani business family, Alshair Fiyaz developed an investment career through ALFI and related holding companies. He moved beyond the family’s textile-derived starting position by acquiring controlling and minority stakes across shipping, energy and European retail, including Global Oceanic Carriers and Eland Oil & Gas.

In Denmark, Fiyaz partnered with Straumur to acquire Magasin du Nord and Illum-related property interests, then used Solstra vehicles for further hospitality and real-estate investments. These interests were organized through controlled companies and trusts, separating beneficial ownership from the individual operating businesses. The pattern is that of a private investor assembling assets across sectors, not an operator identified with one enduring industry.
